subject: mathematics
concept: Reading, writing, and understanding place value for numbers up to 100,000
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a large number using virtual place-value blocks (ten-thousands to ones)
exercise.pictorial: Student reads a place-value chart and writes the matching number
exercise.abstract: Student writes numbers up to 100,000 in words and in digits

misconception_flags: misplaces a digit's value when a place is zero (e.g. 40,506)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
